projecthero.guide.starfire.body: Koriand'r of Tamaran: a princess from another world who flies on joy, drinks in sunlight and fires green starbolts powered by her feelings. Becoming Starfire replaces whatever Primary power you held. It never changes your skin: your fists glow green when a starbolt is ready.
projecthero.guide.starfire.mood.body: The gauge has one needle between Joy (left) and Fury (right). Joy builds while you fly, stand in the sun, eat and stay near squadmates; it makes your flight up to 40% faster and cheaper. Fury builds when you are hurt or a squadmate within 16 blocks is hurt; it makes starbolts, Star Burst and the Barrage hit up to 60% harder but your flight heavier. At full Fury Supernova unlocks. The needle slowly drifts back to the middle.
